summary.text: Brad Barnhill, an Independent American Party candidate and Navy veteran and paralegal, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Secretary of State of Nevada to Francisco Aguilar.
He campaigned as "your independent voice" on voter ID rollout, voter-roll maintenance and repealing the Commerce Tax.

paragraphs.text: Barnhill served in the U.S. Navy and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Virginia in 1981.
He has worked as a federal contractor, systems analyst, paralegal and consultant.
He has chaired the Clark County Central Committee of the Independent American Party and served as vice chairman of the state party.
Barnhill was the party's candidate in state Senate District 6 in 2024, receiving about 2,000 votes.
He received 1.5% of the vote to Francisco Aguilar's 57.0%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
